start:
@startuml
(*) --> "Receive Order"
"Receive Order" --> [paid] "Check Stock"
if "In stock?" then
  --> [yes] "Ship Order"
else
  --> [no] "Back Order"
endif
"Ship Order" --> (*)
"Back Order" --> (*)
@enduml

target.name: Element Back Order — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Connected "Back Order" to "Check Stock". Edit the selected relation in Properties.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — Back Order → Check Stock":
  - heading "Relation — Back Order → Check Stock" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Flow" [selected]
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "__initial__ - Initial pseudostate"
    - option "Receive Order"
    - option "Check Stock"
    - option "decision_1 - In stock?"
    - option "Ship Order"
    - option "Back Order" [selected]
    - option "__final__1 - Final pseudostate"
    - option "__final__2 - Final pseudostate"
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "__initial__ - Initial pseudostate"
    - option "Receive Order"
    - option "Check Stock" [selected]
    - option "decision_1 - In stock?"
    - option "Ship Order"
    - option "Back Order"
    - option "__final__1 - Final pseudostate"
    - option "__final__2 - Final pseudostate"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - button "Invert direction"
  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
